target: call_sol.sh — system and task prompts are byte-identical across transports
cmd: A="$PWD/a.json"; B="$PWD/b.json"; cat "$FIXTURES/sol-transport/brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openai-ok.json" SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$A" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary >/dev/null 2>&1; cat "$FIXTURES/sol-transport/brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openrouter-with-cost.json" SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$B" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter >/dev/null 2>&1; jq -r ".instructions" "$A" > sysA; jq -r ".input[0].content" "$A" > taskA; jq -r ".messages[0].content" "$B" > sysB; jq -r ".messages[1].content" "$B" > taskB; cmp -s sysA sysB && cmp -s taskA taskB && [ -s sysA ] && [ -s taskA ] && echo IDENTICAL
